**Brief Solutions:**

- **[id 150]**: Steve takes $(3 \times 5280) / 440 = 36$ minutes. Tim takes $(2 \times 5280) / 264 = 40$ minutes. Steve waits $40 - 36 = 4$ minutes.
- **[id 151]**: Total tires inflated = $(5 \times 2) + (3 \times 3) + (1 \times 1) = 20$ tires. Earnings = $20 \times \$0.25 = \$5$.
- **[id 152]**: Total cookies = $10 \times 6 = 60$. Total cost = $60 \times \$0.10 = \$6$. Change = $\$10 - \$6 = \$4$.
- **[id 153]**: Let initial pack be $N$. Dave ate 14, seagull ate 7, pigeons ate 9 (remaining before raccoon $= N - 30$). Raccoon takes $2/3$, leaving $1/3$. Ants take 1 leaving 5: $\frac{1}{3}(N - 30) - 1 = 5 \implies N - 30 = 18 \implies N = 48$.
- **[id 154]**: Mon/Wed/Fri: $3 \times 3 \times 1 = 9$ hours. Tue/Thu: $2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8$ hours. Total per week = $17$ hours. In 16 weeks: $16 \times 17 = 272$ hours.
- **[id 155]**: Rolls: $300 \times 4\text{ in} = 1200\text{ in} = 100\text{ ft}$. Croissants: $120 \times 6\text{ in} = 720\text{ in} = 60\text{ ft}$. Baguettes: $60 \times 2\text{ ft} = 120\text{ ft}$. Total = $100 + 60 + 120 = 280$ feet.
- **[id 156]**: Per month = $200 + 400 + 100 = 700$ bananas. For 2 months: $700 \times 2 = 1400$ bananas.
- **[id 157]**: Blake runs $15 \times 200 = 3000$ yards. Kelly runs $1 \times 200 + 34 \times 80 = 2920$ yards. Blake runs $3000 - 2920 = 80$ yards farther.
- **[id 158]**: Pens: $4 \times 1.5 = \$6$. Notebooks: $2 \times 4 = \$8$. Paper: $\$20$. Total = $6 + 8 + 20 = \$34$.
- **[id 159]**: Starting visible: 11. Emerge: $+6$. Hide: $-2$. Currently visible: $11 + 6 - 2 = 15$ tadpoles.
